title: How OPEN AI worth $300 billion in just 10 years...
description:
How this company worth $300 billion in just 10 years...



OpenAI's journey from a nonprofit founded in 2015 to a $300 billion AI giant is one of the fastest business success stories in history. Fueled by Microsoft's multibillion-dollar investment and the explosive success of ChatGPT, the company transformed the AI industry and became one of the world's most valuable private companies—all within just 10 years.
